plan.title: Add parallel agents to festina-finalize for docs phase
plan.overview: Refactor Phase 2 (Documentation) in festina-finalize skill to spawn parallel agents for product and engineering doc updates instead of executing sequentially. The orchestrator pre-loads smart context and current doc content, spawns agents conditionally based on task's affects/engineering fields, validates agent outputs before writing, then commits all changes atomically. This follows the proven parallel agent pattern from festina-scope (lines 154-273) where 4 agents are spawned in a single message using Task tool.

approach.rationale:
Following established patterns: - Parallel Task Execution: festina-scope SKILL.md:155-270 demonstrates spawning multiple agents in single message - Parallel Block XML Structure: Use <parallel> containing <agent> elements with subagent_type="Explore" - Conditional Agent Spawning: Use when="condition" attribute (festina-explore:119) - Orchestrator Decomposition: .festinalente/engineering/patterns/orchestrator.md - split concerns into focused agents
Key architectural decisions from spec: 1. Agents return structured summaries (not full file diffs) to reduce context overhead 2. Orchestrator writes all files (agents don't write) - prevents race conditions and enables atomic commit 3. Glossary and _index.md updates handled by orchestrator after agents complete 4. Single user checkpoint before spawning shows both product AND engineering analysis together 5. Agent prompts must be self-contained since agents don't inherit conversation history

task.name: Refactor analyze_doc_impact to combined analysis with pre-loading
task.action:
Refactor the `analyze_doc_impact` step (lines 305-318) to:
1. Keep the existing needsProductDocs/needsEngineeringDocs detection logic 2. Add pre-loading of smart context ONCE before showing checkpoint: - If needsProductDocs: `node .festinalente/scripts/select-context.cjs {taskId} --tier=standard --max=3 --type=product` - If needsEngineeringDocs: `node .festinalente/scripts/select-context.cjs {taskId} --tier=standard --max=3 --type=engineering` 3. Add pre-fetching of current doc content: - For each doc ID in affects: read `.festinalente/product/{path}.md` - For each doc ID in engineering: read `.festinalente/engineering/{path}.md` (using ID→path rules) 4. Run categorization scripts: - If needsProductDocs: `node .festinalente/scripts/check-product.cjs {affects IDs}` - If needsEngineeringDocs: `node .festinalente/scripts/check-engineering.cjs {engineering IDs}` 5. Replace two separate AskUserQuestion prompts (lines 332-339, 364-371) with SINGLE combined checkpoint showing: - Product Doc Analysis (if applicable) - Engineering Doc Analysis (if applicable) - Single confirmation to proceed with all documentation updates
Current structure (lines 305-318): ```xml <step name="analyze_doc_impact" when="resumeFrom is phase1 or phase2" outputs="needsProductDocs, needsEngineeringDocs"> <action>Check task's `affects` element for product docs</action> <action>Check task's `engineering` element for engineering docs</action> <branch condition="affects is empty AND engineering is empty AND labels include [bug, refactor, chore]"> <output>No documentation updates needed (internal change)</output> <action>Set needsProductDocs = false, needsEngineeringDocs = false</action> </branch> <branch condition="affects has values"> <action>Set needsProductDocs = true</action> </branch> <branch condition="engineering has values"> <action>Set needsEngineeringDocs = true</action> </branch> </step> ```
Change to include: - New outputs: productContext, engineeringContext, currentProductDocs, currentEngineeringDocs - Pre-load smart context - Pre-fetch current doc content - Combined user checkpoint
task.done: analyze_doc_impact step pre-loads context, pre-fetches docs, shows combined analysis checkpoint

task.name: Replace sequential doc update steps with parallel agent spawning
task.pattern: Parallel Task Execution at festina-scope SKILL.md:158-270
task.action:
Replace the two sequential steps: - `update_product_docs` (lines 320-349) - `update_engineering_docs` (lines 352-380)
With a single `spawn_doc_agents` step containing:
1. A <parallel> block with two <agent> elements:
**Product Docs Agent** (when="needsProductDocs is true"): - subagent_type="general-purpose" - Prompt must include: - Task context: taskId, title, affects field, acceptance criteria - Reference content: embed key sections from docs-product.md - Current doc content: from pre-fetched currentProductDocs - Smart context: from pre-loaded productContext - Categories: stubDocs, existingDocs, missingDocs - Instructions: complete stubs, update existing, create new - Output format: {filesChanged: [{path, action}], summary: string, validationErrors: []}
**Engineering Docs Agent** (when="needsEngineeringDocs is true"): - subagent_type="general-purpose" - Prompt must include: - Task context: taskId, title, engineering field, acceptance criteria - Reference content: embed key sections from docs-engineering.md - Current doc content: from pre-fetched currentEngineeringDocs - Smart context: from pre-loaded engineeringContext - Categories: engStubDocs, engExistingDocs, engMissingDocs - Instructions: complete stubs, update existing, create new (type-specific) - Output format: {filesChanged: [{path, action}], summary: string, validationErrors: []}
2. Note explaining: "Use Task tool invocations in a SINGLE message to achieve parallelism"
3. After parallel block: <action>Wait for agents to complete and collect results</action>
Reference pattern from festina-scope:158: ```xml <parallel> <agent name="Product Context Researcher" subagent_type="Explore"> <description>Find product docs and constraints</description> <prompt> Research product context for task: "{title}" ... </prompt> </agent> </parallel> ```
task.verify: grep -A 3 "<parallel>" apps/festinalente/src/content/skills/festina-finalize/SKILL.md | grep -E "(Product Docs Agent|Engineering Docs Agent)"
task.done: Phase 2 has parallel block with conditional Product and Engineering agents

task.name: Add validate_agent_outputs step with error handling
task.action:
Add new step `validate_agent_outputs` after spawn_doc_agents:
1. Collect results from both agents (if spawned) 2. Check each agent result for errors: - If agent returned validationErrors array with items, it's an error - If agent failed to complete (Task tool error), it's an error
3. Error handling branch (when any agent has errors): ```xml <branch condition="any agent returned error"> <output>Agent Error Details:</output> <output>{agent name}: {error details}</output> <action>Use AskUserQuestion tool with: - header: "Agent Error" - question: "Documentation agent encountered an error. How should I proceed?" - options: - label: "Retry", description: "Re-run the failed agent(s)" - label: "Skip", description: "Continue without that agent's documentation" - label: "Abort", description: "Cancel Phase 2 documentation" - multiSelect: false </action> </branch> ```
4. Success branch: combine filesChanged lists, prepare for writing
Reference pattern from festina-scope:276: ```xml <step name="synthesize_research" outputs="synthesis"> <note>Consolidate all research findings into a structured summary.</note> <branch condition="researchDepth is 'Deep'"> <action>Combine outputs from all 4 agents</action> <action>Deduplicate findings</action> <action>Resolve conflicts using these rules:</action> </branch> </step> ```
task.done: validate_agent_outputs step exists with error handling and AskUserQuestion for retry/skip/abort

task.name: Update commit_docs step for orchestrator-handled updates and atomic commit
task.action:
Refactor `commit_docs` step (lines 382-396) to:
1. Add pre-commit actions for orchestrator-handled updates: - Update glossary.yaml if new terms were introduced (check agent summaries) - Update domain _index.md files if new docs were created - Run validation: `node .festinalente/scripts/validate-docs.cjs {all changed doc paths}`
2. Keep existing atomic commit structure but ensure it stages all changes: ``` git add .festinalente/product/ git add .festinalente/engineering/ git add .festinalente/glossary.yaml ```
3. Use existing commit message format (already correct): - Both: `docs({taskId}): product+engineering - {description}` - Product only: `docs({taskId}): product - {description}` - Engineering only: `docs({taskId}): engineering - {description}`
Current code (lines 382-396): ```xml <step name="commit_docs" when="docs were created or updated"> <command>git add .festinalente/product/</command> <command>git add .festinalente/engineering/</command> <command>git add .festinalente/glossary.yaml</command> <branch condition="both product and engineering"> <command>git commit -m "docs({taskId}): product+engineering - {description}"</command> </branch> ... </step> ```
Add before git commands: ```xml <action>Update glossary.yaml if agent summaries mention new terms</action> <action>Update domain _index.md files if new docs were created</action> <action>Run validation on all changed docs</action> <command>node .festinalente/scripts/validate-docs.cjs {changed doc paths from agent results}</command> ```
task.done: commit_docs handles glossary/index updates and validates before atomic commit

pitfalls.pitfall: Agent prompts must include ALL context explicitly - task details, acceptance criteria, current doc content, reference file sections. Agents cannot access conversation history.
Mitigated by design: agents don't write files, orchestrator handles glossary after collecting all agent results.
Agents return structured summary {filesChanged, summary, validationErrors} not full file diffs. Orchestrator reads from disk if needed.
Mitigated by design: agents don't stage/commit. Orchestrator does all git operations in single critical section after validation.
Must show COMBINED analysis for both product AND engineering before any agents spawn. Single decision point.
If user selects retry, only re-spawn the failed agent(s), not both.
